title: silicone microwave mat
text: silicone microwave mat. I purchased these to use as bowl covers in the microwave (instead of a paper plate).  They are nice and large.  But they are super thin - really, really thin.  I was hoping for a bit thicker, but I think it will work.  While they are dishwasher safe -  it would take the whole top rack basket to wash - so I am hand washing.  They are bright red.  I am going to look for something a tad thicker, but these will work for now.

product_metadata.title: BESKIT 3 Pack 12 inches Silicone Microwave Mat Non-Stick BPA Free Oven Mat Multi-Purpose Heat Resistant Turntable Mat
features: Silicone material: durable silicone material makes the oven heat mat non-stick and easy clean up.
Proper size: 12 inches diameter oven hot pad fits most turntables, and it also can be cut to fit your different turntables.

Multi-purpose: the round baking mat is suitable for kitchen, home and daily use, can be considered as a coaster or pot pad, bassets, splash guards, can openers, place mats, lids, food covers, and so on.
Function: the silicone microwave mats are designed to contain spills, drips and splatters, protecting your glass microwave turntable.
Warm note: the round microwave mat can be applied to microwave heating, oven baked, non-direct contact with flame cooking, cold storage and freezing.
